source.inputs: nrpc-model-explorer data/parcels.parquet (v1 replay of the published run)

sources.label: Protected Areas, 2020 composite
sources.agency: Hennepin County composite of: Established Conservation Easements (county), National Wildlife Refuges (US Fish and Wildlife Service), Parks of Natural Resource Significance (county), Wildlife Management Areas (DNR), Scientific and Natural Areas (DNR), TNC Lands (The Nature Conservancy), Aquatic Management Areas (DNR)
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Natural Spaces (ecologically significant MLCCS areas)
sources.agency: Hennepin County (subset of MLCCS) plus Priority Natural Resource Corridors
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Minnesota Land Cover Classification System (MLCCS)
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Minnesota Biological Survey (MBS) sites of biodiversity significance
sources.terms: Minnesota Geospatial Commons, DNR open data

sources.label: Minnesota Biological Survey (MBS) sites of biodiversity significance
sources.terms: Minnesota Geospatial Commons, DNR open data

sources.label: MLCCS A or B quality communities
sources.agency: Hennepin County (MLCCS query M_34X = 'A' OR M_34X = 'B')
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Habitat diversity, MLCCS level 3 (Gini-Simpson)
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Parcel polygons (v1 analysis set, 445,517 parcels)
sources.agency: Hennepin County parcels (Analysis Easements, Public Works Environment SDE)

sources.label: Wildlife Action Network (WAN)
sources.agency: Minnesota DNR, Minnesota Wildlife Action Plan
sources.terms: Minnesota Geospatial Commons, DNR open data

sources.label: Risk of development, 2019 University of Minnesota methodology (2020 layer)
sources.agency: University of Minnesota methodology; county inputs: Generalized Land Use 2016 'Undeveloped' (Met Council), HCWI probable wetlands, PWI basins (DNR), cemeteries (MetroGIS parcels), Protected Areas
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: Shoreland buffer areas (PWI watercourses and basins)
sources.agency: Minnesota DNR Public Waters Inventory, buffered by Hennepin County
sources.terms: 2020 analysis geodatabase assembled by Hennepin County for the easement model; composite of county and public layers

sources.label: FEMA floodplains (100-year and 500-year)
sources.agency: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), county GIS warehouse

sources.label: Hennepin County Wetland Inventory (HCWI)
sources.terms: Hennepin County GIS warehouse layer shared for the NRPC model

sources.label: Headwater catchments (DNR level 9 watersheds)
sources.terms: Minnesota Geospatial Commons, DNR open data

sources.label: Mean groundwater recharge 1996-2010
sources.agency: US Geological Survey (statewide raster), vectorized by Hennepin County

rank.protected_rule: Already protected: at least 50% of the parcel's area in the 2020 protected-areas composite, the 2026 easement compilation, Three Rivers gap parks or parks of natural resource significance.
rank.msp_rule: MSP Airport: county parcel layer municipality 'MET AIRPORT'.
